item.text: The telemetry payload is built in `internal/telemetry/telemetry.go`. Audit configuration already has separate `Enabled` flags for the log file and webhook sinks, so I’ll use those flags and omit the audit object when neither is enabled.

The payload change is in place, and the telemetry package tests pass. The added cases cover each sink alone, both sinks, and configured sink details with both `Enabled` flags off. I’ll review the diff and check the persisted schema version next.

item.text:
Updated anonymous telemetry to version `1.3`. When audit sinks are enabled, the payload includes `audit.sinks` with `log`, `webhook`, or both; when neither is enabled, it omits `audit`.

Added coverage for all sink combinations in [telemetry_test.go](/app/internal/telemetry/telemetry_test.go). `go test ./internal/telemetry` and `git diff --check` passed.
